minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  September 29, 2020

  The Parking Authority of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on
  Tuesday, September 29, 2020, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.
  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, Finance
  Authority, Parking Authority, and Joint Powers Authority at the hour of 2:02 p.m.
  The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary/ Finance
  Authority Secretary/Parking Authority Secretary/Joint Powers Authority Secretary
  announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman/Finance  Authority  Chairman/  Parking
  Authority Chairman/ Joint Powers Authority Chairman
  Butts,  Council  Members/Successor  Agency
  Members/Housing  Authority  Members/  Finance
  Authority Members/ Parking Authority Members/ Joint
  Powers Authority Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and
  Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.

.  City/Successor Agency / Housing Authority/Finance Authority/ Parking Authority / Joint
  Powers Authority officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  David Esparza  Asst. City Manager/CFO
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

  * Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority, Finance
  Authority, Parking Authority, Joint Powers Authority.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS.  Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman/Finance Authority Chairman/Parking Authority
  Chairman/Joint Powers Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons
  present who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing
  Authority/Finance Authority/Parking Authority/Joint Powers Authority on any item on
  the Agendas.

  Gil Mathieu, District 4 resident, spoke concerning Agenda Items Nos. 1, CSA-2, and H-
  1, Warrant Register, and Amendment Three to Agreement No. 19-077 for the Welfare-to-
  Work Vocational, Intermediary and Direct Services.

  Bill (No last name given), spoke concerning Agenda Item Nos. 5, Amendment No. 1 to
  Agreement No. 17-541 with County Hills Animal Clinic, and DR-5, Resolution to amend
  the Policies and Procedures Manual for the Inglewood COVID-19 Debit Card Program.

  PARKING AUTHORITY MINUTES. It was moved by Parking Authority Member
  Franklin, and seconded by Parking Authority Member Padilla that the Minutes for the
  Parking Authority Meetings held on March 17, 2020, and March 24, 2020, be approved.
  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Parking Authority Members Padilla, Morales, Dotson, Franklin, and Parking
  Authority Chairman Butts;
  Noes: None.

  There being no further business to be presented, Parking Authority Chairman Butts
  declared the meeting adjourned at the hour of 2:39 p.m.
 September 29, 2020

  Approved this _____ day of a _____________ 2021.
